sentences.text: Constellate computed a modest symptom similarity between mucopolysaccharidosis type 3D and GM1 gangliosidosis, with a score of 0.211 over 15 shared terms [e_87691e655721].
This link is inferred, meaning Constellate calculated it, and it is not a database finding [e_87691e655721].
The genes behind them, GNS and GLB1, are both recorded in the same pathway for breaking down keratan sulfate [e_50b1a2a85102] [e_10f453590dd2].
Type 3D is curated as caused by GNS, while GM1 gangliosidosis is linked to GLB1 only by an inferred roll-up from subtypes at confidence 0.475 [e_1a3b6f1c88e1] [e_4b6a2b49884c].

GM1 gangliosidosis has two studies on ClinicalTrials.gov, a prenatal gene transfer study not yet recruiting and a recruiting study of an oral drug called nizubaglustat [e_c96cb9bc9690] [e_2002d33295d6].
A research grant for an AAV approach is also recorded, and one patient group link comes from unverified text mining [e_d8e337b6892d] [e_b7708b486598].
For type 3D, two observed features are listed, heparan sulfate in urine and excess facial hair, the second from a single report [e_06cb5bccfbf4] [e_e34f33cea0d4].
These edges do not show that the GM1 studies apply to type 3D, and they do not show that any drug works [e_87691e655721] [e_c96cb9bc9690] [e_2002d33295d6].
